card.name: Digit 4 inside reference numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 4 as the first digit of a number group inside ISBNs, Nature volume or page numbers, and phone numbers. It appears in citation and contact lines.

modes.label: ISBN digits
modes.description: The digit 4 starting a group within an ISBN.

modes.label: Nature citation numbers
modes.description: The digit 4 starting a volume or page number in a Nature journal reference.

modes.label: Phone numbers
modes.description: The digit 4 starting a segment of a phone number.

card.writes: It suppresses odd tokens such as 'teen' and 'teenth', and promotes word endings, which suggests it keeps the digit string going rather than forming a word.
card.plain: It marks a digit 4 that begins a chunk of a code, such as an ISBN, journal volume, or phone number.
